title: Parks Master Plan: Places recommendations session
subtitle: Council gave feedback on 50 draft recommendations covering equity, land protection, future planning and park experiences.
overview: A special meeting of Council was held to review progress on the Places portion of the Parks Master Plan, through report INS-2024-347. It was a strategic session for feedback. The minutes record no motions, and Council made no formal decisions.

Staff explained they had engaged Kitchener residents to assess how well parks and open spaces serve community needs, and the quality of amenities in them. Equity was the overarching theme from that engagement. Staff said it included conversations with equity-deserving groups. From the feedback, staff developed 50 recommendations in four categories: parks as inclusive spaces, protection of land for parks, park planning for the future, and reimagining park experiences.

Council members were asked for reflections on each category, any concerns, and what excited them most, using an interactive polling exercise. For residents, the session shapes the direction of future park planning, amenities and land protection. The meeting adjourned at 6:12 p.m.
